{{Quote|My husband, King Cana, ruled for thirty years. His intentions were good, but corruption invaded our council of ministers and governors of the surrounding provinces. A handful of powerful families controlled the high posts. My husband was not able to stop it.|Veda|<ref name="MTC" />}}
'''Cana''' was the one time [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Gala]]. He was married to [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]], who ruled in his stead, after his death. He was married to [[Tema]] before his arranged marriage, and fathered [[Elan Tallah]]. As king, he fathered [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Beju]] and taught him everything about [[Sword/Legends|sword]] dueling.<ref name="MTC" />
